A ready hold stays on the hold shelf until its ready_until date (inclusive): hold_shelf_days after it became ready. After that date it has expired and may be cancelled.
The pickup branch can only be changed on a hold that is waiting; a suspended hold must be reactivated first. Holds that are in transit or ready cannot be redirected. New pickup branches must be open.

Copies can be marked missing or withdrawn only while on the open shelf (or, for withdrawn, while missing).

A patron cannot place a hold on a title of which they currently have a copy on loan.
Blocked patrons cannot place holds, and their existing holds are passed over when copies are handed out (they keep their place in the queue).
Queue order: a copy may only fill the OLDEST eligible waiting hold on its title. Eligible means status waiting, patron not blocked, and pickup branch open. Suspended holds are passed over.
Only copies that are on the open shelf, in good or worn condition (never damaged), at an open branch can fill a hold or be sent anywhere.
A ready hold stays on the hold shelf until its ready_until date (inclusive): hold_shelf_days after it became ready. After that date it has expired and may be cancelled.
The pickup branch can only be changed on a hold that is waiting; a suspended hold must be reactivated first. Holds that are in transit or ready cannot be redirected. New pickup branches must be open.
Holds in transit cannot be cancelled until the copy has been received.
Copies can be marked missing or withdrawn only while on the open shelf (or, for withdrawn, while missing).
